boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain San Jose State University
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe food destinations in San Jose with directly published late-night hours. Confirm the applicable day and service mode before leaving.

cards.title: IHOP on North First Street
cards.subtitle: 644 N 1st St · San Jose
cards.notes: Use the 24-hour dining room when you need a meal after campus programming; check the location page before departing for service updates.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour pancake-and-diner option north of downtown.
cards.evidence_claim: IHOP’s official location page lists this 644 N 1st St restaurant as open 24 hours every day.
cards.source_title: IHOP — Late Night Food at 644 N 1st St
cards.access_notes: Official page lists restaurant hours as open 24 hours Monday–Sunday.

cards.title: Denny’s on North First Street
cards.subtitle: 2077 North 1st Street · San Jose
cards.notes: Plan a sit-down diner stop north of downtown when later food is needed; the official page lists near-round-the-clock daily store hours.
cards.short_summary: A diner destination with daily hours extending to 11:58 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Denny’s official page says the 2077 North 1st Street location is open around the clock and lists 12 a.m.–11:58 p.m. daily.
cards.access_notes: Official store hours: 12:00 a.m.–11:58 p.m., Monday–Sunday.

cards.title: Wendy’s on Monterey Road
cards.subtitle: 1405 Monterey Rd · San Jose
cards.notes: Keep this Monterey Road location in mind for a midnight food pickup; its official listing provides restaurant and drive-thru hours for every day.
cards.short_summary: A midnight option south of downtown.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy’s official location page lists restaurant and drive-thru hours of 6:30 a.m.–12 a.m. daily at 1405 Monterey Rd.
cards.access_notes: Official restaurant and drive-thru hours are 6:30 a.m.–12:00 a.m., Monday–Sunday.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Monterey Road
cards.subtitle: 2284 Monterey Road · San Jose
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru if you are out late: this location’s official page distinguishes drive-thru hours from earlier dine-in hours.
cards.short_summary: A Monterey Road drive-thru with late and 24-hour periods.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s official page lists drive-thru service until 2 a.m. most days and 24 hours Thursday through Saturday at 2284 Monterey Road.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell — 2284 Monterey Road, San Jose
cards.access_notes: Official drive-thru hours: until 2:00 a.m. most days; open 24 hours Thursday–Saturday. Dine-in closes earlier.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Alum Rock Avenue
cards.subtitle: 2770 Alum Rock Ave · San Jose
cards.notes: For an East San Jose late run, use the drive-thru schedule rather than assuming the dining room is open; indoor hours end earlier.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour drive-thru location on Alum Rock Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s official location page lists drive-thru hours as open 24 hours every day at 2770 Alum Rock Ave.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell — 2770 Alum Rock Ave, San Jose
cards.access_notes: Official drive-thru hours are open 24 hours Monday–Sunday; listed dine-in hours are 7:00 a.m.–11:00 p.m.

cards.entity_name: Orale Taco Truck, 2240 Alum Rock Ave
cards.title: Orale Taco Truck on Alum Rock
cards.subtitle: 2240 Alum Rock Ave · San Jose
cards.notes: Choose the Alum Rock truck, not its East Julian location, for the late schedule; Friday and Saturday service is listed through 3 a.m.
cards.short_summary: A taco-truck stop with late weekend hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Orale Taco Truck’s official site lists its 2240 Alum Rock Ave location open until 1 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 3 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Orale Taco Truck — Locations and Business Hours
cards.access_notes: Official hours for 2240 Alum Rock Ave: until 1:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 3:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: Wendy’s on McKee Road
cards.subtitle: 2275 McKee Road · San Jose
cards.notes: Check the individual restaurant page before heading east from campus, especially if you need a later weekday drive-thru or counter pickup.
cards.short_summary: A McKee Road restaurant listed as open late.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy’s official San Jose location directory lists the 2275 McKee Road restaurant as open until 2 a.m.
cards.access_notes: Wendy’s official San Jose directory lists 2275 McKee Road as open until 2:00 a.m.; verify daily service details before visiting.

cards.title: Carl’s Jr. on Coleman Avenue
cards.subtitle: 655 Coleman Ave · San Jose
cards.notes: Use this Coleman Avenue location for a weekend late-food option; the official location page posts different weekday and Friday–Saturday closing times.
cards.short_summary: A Coleman Avenue restaurant with 2 a.m. weekend hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Carl’s Jr.’s official page lists the 655 Coleman Ave location open until 2 a.m. Friday and Saturday, and until midnight other days.
cards.source_title: Carl’s Jr. — 655 Coleman Ave, San Jose
cards.access_notes: Official hours: until 12:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 2:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: Taco Bell on West Capitol Expressway
cards.subtitle: 535 W Capitol Expressway · San Jose
cards.notes: For a very late drive-thru run, confirm the day’s service before you go; the location page posts 4 a.m. drive-thru closing times.
cards.short_summary: A West Capitol Expressway drive-thru listed through 4 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s official page lists drive-thru hours of 7 a.m.–4 a.m. daily at 535 W Capitol Expressway.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell — 535 W Capitol Expressway, San Jose
cards.access_notes: Official drive-thru hours are listed as 7:00 a.m.–4:00 a.m. daily; dine-in hours end at 10:00 p.m.

cards.entity_name: Top Cafe, 1075 S De Anza Blvd
cards.title: Top Cafe on South De Anza Boulevard
cards.subtitle: 1075 S De Anza Blvd · San Jose
cards.notes: Treat this as a farther San Jose option and check the day before traveling; the business posts later Friday and Saturday pickup hours.
cards.short_summary: A pickup-focused cafe with late nightly hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Top Cafe’s official website lists hours until 1 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 3 a.m. Friday–Saturday at 1075 S De Anza Blvd.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists pickup-only hours until 1:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 3:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
